d: US President Donald Trump has defended America's military campaign against Iran, declaring that the United States has won the war but wants a complete victory. Trump claimed Iran had been waging war against America since 1979 and said his administration had finally fought back. He asserted that US military operations had prevented Tehran from obtaining nuclear weapons and destroyed capabilities that could take Iran 25 years to rebuild.
